title: Sheaf-Based Federated Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.10016v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Heterogeneous federated systems require agents to learn and exchange informative representations despite differences in data distributions, model architectures, and latent dimensionalities. We propose Sheaf-based Federated Representation Learning (SFRL), a framework that jointly learns and aligns heterogeneous latent representations without sharing parameters, labels, or a single latent space. SFRL relates agent-specific latent spaces through learnable orthogonal transformations and isometric embeddings, promoting consistency via a sheaf-Laplacian gluing regularizer evaluated on a shared set of pilot samples. We develop Sheaf-FRL, a decentralized alternating algorithm combining local gradient updates with closed-form Procrustes updates of the alignment maps, and establish convergence guarantees in deterministic and stochastic settings. translated_title: 基于束的联邦表示学习
translated_abstract: 异构联邦系统要求各智能体在数据分布、模型架构和潜在维度存在差异的情况下，仍能学习并交换有信息量的表示。我们提出了基于束的联邦表示学习，这是一个无需共享参数、标签或单一潜在空间，即可联合学习并对齐异构潜在表示的框架。SFRL 通过可学习的正交变换和等距嵌入来关联各智能体特定的潜在空间，并通过在一组共享导频样本上评估的束-拉普拉斯粘合正则化器来促进一致性。我们开发了 Sheaf-FRL，这是一种去中心化的交替算法，它将局部梯度更新与对齐映射的闭式 Procrustes 更新相结合，并在确定性和随机设置下建立了收敛性保证。在跨四个数据集、结合语义通信的协同分类任务中，在模型……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于束的联邦表示学习框架 SFRL，它无需共享参数、标签或统一潜在空间，通过可学习的正交变换、等距嵌入和束-拉普拉斯粘合正则化器，联合学习并对齐异构联邦智能体的潜在表示，且具有收敛性理论保证。
en_tdlr: We propose Sheaf-based Federated Representation Learning (SFRL), a framework that jointly learns and aligns heterogeneous latent representations across federated agents without sharing parameters, labels, or a single latent space, using learnable orthogonal transformations, isometric embeddings, and a sheaf-Laplacian gluing regularizer, with proven convergence guarantees.
